item.title: David Grant Mollett
item.description: David Mollett was an avid collector of memorabilia and coins. He enjoyed bowling, dabbled in golfing, and enjoyed a healthy competition no matter the game. Read more: David Grant Mollett

item.title: New Walmart coming to CR 484 in Ocala
item.description: A new, massive retail development along the County Road 484 in south Ocala has been identified as a future Walmart, marking the latest addition to the rapidly expanding corridor. Read more: New Walmart coming to CR 484 in Ocala

item.title: Linda Lee Cannady
item.description: Linda Cannady was an amazing seamstress, an excellent bowler which was her favorite activity. She was the best cook and could turn simple cakes into masterpieces. She had the most beautiful voice. Read more: Linda Lee Cannady

item.title: Bluegrass music festival returns to downtown Ocala this weekend
item.description: The city will host its third annual bluegrass music festival this weekend with several nationally known bands and food trucks. Read more: Bluegrass music festival returns to downtown Ocala this weekend

item.title: Rosemary Farmer
item.description: Rosemary Farmer found joy in garage sailing, thrift shopping, and lingering moments spent with those she loved most, moments that now live on as treasured memories. Read more: Rosemary Farmer

item.title: Driver killed in fatal accident along Ocala roadway
item.description: A motorist died following a two-vehicle collision early Wednesday morning that shut down a busy stretch of South Pine Avenue in Ocala for several hours. Read more: Driver killed in fatal accident along Ocala roadway

item.title: Mother sues Airbnb, homeowners after child’s near-drowning at Ocala rental
item.description: A Gainesville mother has filed a lawsuit against Airbnb and three homeowners after her child allegedly suffered severe injuries in a near-drowning incident at a short-term rental property in Ocala. Read more: Mother sues Airbnb, homeowners after child’s near-drowning at Ocala rental
